3.finding: After the CP119 comparability challenge, all three programmes meaningfully respond to the target rather than merely forming coherent curricula. They combine 52.5–60 EC of direct philosophy, political philosophy, law-and-philosophy or applied ethics with a genuine second discipline. Visible limitations prevent this from being read as equivalence to the 90-EC philosophy-and-integration component.
preserved: All three concepts, sequential candidate ownership, labels, neutral closest route and maximum-reached stopping state.
